Subject: Partner idea — hands-on codelab roadshow with Redwood Inference

Hi Kimberly / Jonas,

Hope youre both well. Quick introIm Emma on partnerships at OrbitForge. Weve been running a small series of developer-focused codelabs (60-90 minute hands-on sessions) at regional meetups and are exploring a joint roadshow with Redwood focused on inference in production.

High-level idea: OrbitForge supplies the developer community and local meetup logistics; Redwood provides a short product demo (10-15m) and the core codelab content (30-45m) where we walk attendees through integrating Redwoods hosted API + a small on-prem mock for privacy-conscious examples. Goals are lead gen (targeted) and technical depth to show integration patterns.

Were thinking about 6 cities (SF, NY, London, Berlin, Toronto, Austin) between Nov26 and Feb7. Budget split: OrbitForge covers venues + meetups; we coordinate on speaker travel and a small co-op for ads.

Would love to discuss scope, rough dates, and any compliance/infra constraints (if you need dedicated infra for the labs). If this is interesting, can we set up a 30-min sync next week?

Cheers,
Emma Li
Head of Partnerships, OrbitForge
emma@orbitforge.com

Thanks Emma  this sounds promising. Id like to move fast on a pilot. A few quick confirms from our side: 

- Target audience: developer/ML engineer meetups (not enterprise execs) 
- Session format: 75 minutes recommended (10 min intro, 20 min demo, 40 min hands-on split into two guided exercises)
- Infrastructure: for the hands-on we can either provide access to Redwood hosted API sandbox keys (rate-limited) or spin up a short-lived private deployment per city if wed like to demo Private features. Cost/ops tradeoff to discuss.

Ben and Laura are looping in to handle partner commercial bits and event promotion. Jonas, can your team comment on the sandbox capacity tradeoffs and an expected attendees-to-connections ratio we should plan for?

Emma  if you have preferred pilot cities & weekend vs. weekday constraints, share them and well map dates. 30-min sync next Tue (9/8) 10:30am PT works for me if that works on your side.

Best,

Hey all, thanks for the context. A few technical items to flag so the lab is smooth:

1) Sandbox keys: we can provision per-event API keys with request quotas and morning/afternoon refresh windows. Thats lowest ops.
2) Private demo option: to demo sensitivity controls (VPC, KMS) requires >48h lead time per city; wed need infrastructure requests and possible network config at venue.
3) Typical workshop scale weve done: 30-60 attendees. Plan for 40 concurrent active sessions. We recommend a 1:8 TA-to-attendee ratio for first-time labs.
4) Session laptop image: participants will need python 3.11, pip, and a simple starter repo. Im attaching a brief site requirements checklist for venues that OrbitForge can use when confirming locations.

Attachments: site_requirements.pdf

If we go with hosted sandbox, cost estimate per event is modest; if we spin up private infra for demos, add a modest ops fee and scheduling window. Happy to walk through at the sync.

-Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
